items.text: bill galat hai
amount zyada hua
check kar lo
short_with_context
yeh mera bill hai
bill review karna hai
main payment karno chahta hu

items.context: Kya aap apna bill detail bata sakte hain?
items.text: bill toh sahi nahi hai

items.context: Kya aap date batayenge jab extra charges aaye?
items.text: extra charge dikh raha hai

items.context: Kya aap apna account number bata sakte hain?
items.text: mere plan me changes nahi hua
mera last month ka bill bahut zyada aaya hai
maine unlimited plan liya tha par fir bhi extra charge lag gaye
please mera bill check karke batao galti hai ya nahi
aapke system me kuch error hai kyunki yeh charge mujhe samajh nahi aa raha
maine kal payment kiya tha fir bhi mujhe payment due dikh raha hai
kya aap mujhe mere recent calls ki details bhej sakte hain
bill me international call ke liye extra charge nahi hona chahiye tha

items.context: Kya aap apne calls ke detail share karenge?
items.text: maine is mahine ka bill dekha aur kuch calls ka charge double lagaya gaya hai

items.context: Bill ke kis hisse ko aap verify karna chahte hain?
items.text: kya mujhe pata sakte hain ki bill me jo SMS charges aaye wo sahi hain

items.context: Aapke plan me kya included hai uske bare me jankari chahiye?
items.text: charges me kuch extra add hua hai jo mere plan me nahi tha

items.context: Kya aap apna account number confirm karenge?
items.text: mera account number 987654 hai is bill me kuch problem lag rahi hai

items.context: Kya aap payment history check karna chahenge?
items.text: maine autopay set kiya tha payment delay kaise hua ye batayein
mere bill me iss mahine 500 rupees extra charge lagaye gaye hain jo mujhe samajh nahi aa rahe hain
maine jo plan sign up kiya tha uske mutabiq bill me koi extra charges nahi hone chahiye the
please meri madad kijiye kyunki main bill ke charges ko reconcile nahi kar paa raha hu

items.context: Kya aap specific charges batayenge jo aapke bill me galat hain?
items.text: maine apne bill par dekha ki local calls ke bad extra international calls ke charges bhi add ho gaye hain jo maine kiye nahi hain

items.context: Kya aapko billing cycle ki details chahiye?
items.text: agar aap mujhe call details aur billing cycle ke baare me information de sakte hain to main zyada acche se samajh paunga

items.context: Kya aap apni subscription agreement ke baare me kuch detail share karenge?
items.text: kuch charges aise hain jo mere contract ke terms ke against hain aur unko main dispute karna chahta hu

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
